meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 将 Slack 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用里发送或接收 Slack 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send or receive Slack messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会自动复制 Slack 适配器、注册并安装固定版本依赖,引导创建 Slack 应用、填令牌(Socket Mode 或 Webhook),最后重启服务,让机器人收发 Slack 消息。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Slack 频道,或运行 /setup、/init-first-agent、/manage-channels 等设置命令时触发。

say.text: 我要接入 Slack 频道
say.note: 开始执行复制适配器、注册等步骤。

say.text: 用 Socket Mode 接入 Slack
say.note: 引导创建应用并填 xapp- 令牌。

say.text: 把 Slack 事件通过 Webhook 接收
say.note: 需要提供公网 HTTPS 地址。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude copies the Slack adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, then walks the user through creating a Slack app and entering tokens (Socket Mode or webhook), and restarts the service so the bot can send and receive Slack messages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Slack integration, or runs setup commands like /setup, /init-first-agent, or /manage-channels.

say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and registration steps.

say_en.text: Set up Slack with Socket Mode
say_en.note: Guides app creation and xapp- token entry.
Requires a public HTTPS URL for port 3000.
